indication_pass.question: Routine surveillance after treated breast cancer, no new symptoms: do the images show any sign of recurrent or metastatic disease in the chest (lung nodule or mass, pleural effusion, enlarged hila or mediastinum, bone lesion)?
indication_pass.answer: The current film shows no mass, pleural effusion, hilar or mediastinal enlargement, or destructive bone lesion at this resolution. A small dense focus among more conspicuous markings in the medial right lower zone (F2) is not clearly seen on the prior and remains undetermined; it needs review on the source images.
